name: Hostel & Dormitory Fire Safety
description: Routine safety audit for student hostels and residential dormitories checking corridor clearance, fire extinguishers, emergency stairwells, and exit doors.
disclaimer: AuditLens is an assistive pre-audit tool. It does not certify legal compliance. Verify against institutional dormitory regulations and local fire codes.

rules.title: Corridor fire extinguisher is accessible and unblocked
rules.evidence_needed: Visual segmentation mask, confidence >= 0.60, timestamp citation
rules.fix_text: Verify fire extinguisher pressure gauge and clear all laundry bags or drying racks from its front clearance area.

rules.title: Stairwell fire exit sign is clearly visible
rules.evidence_needed: Overhead illuminated directional exit sign leading toward stairwell
rules.fix_text: Replace damaged or unlit stairwell exit signs and verify emergency battery backup functionality.

rules.title: Hostel hallway is free of blocking shoe racks, luggage, and bikes
rules.evidence_needed: Absence of shoe racks, trunks, luggage, mattresses, or bikes in the corridor
rules.fix_text: Remove all shoe racks, personal storage, and bicycles obstructing the dormitory corridor.

rules.title: Corridor maintains minimum clear egress width of 1.2 meters
rules.evidence_needed: Optical measurement >= 1.2m calibrated via A4 visual scale
rules.fix_text: Ensure corridor width remains unobstructed to a minimum of 1.2 meters along the full length of the hall.

rules.title: At least two independent stairwell egress routes are available
rules.evidence_needed: Minimum distinct count of 2 stairwell or external exit doors
rules.fix_text: Ensure both ends of the dormitory wing have accessible, unblocked stairwell access.
